crossRefs.note: Evil shall kill the wicked. Those who hate the righteous shall be condemned.
Yahweh redeems the soul of his servants. None of those who take refuge in him shall be condemned.
“So let all your enemies perish, Yahweh, but let those who love him be as the sun when it rises in its strength.” Then…
Those who trust in Yahweh are as Mount Zion, which can’t be moved, but remains forever.
Happy is he who has the God of Jacob for his help, whose hope is in Yahweh, his God:
“Blessed is the man who trusts in Yahweh, and whose confidence is in Yahweh.
For he will be as a tree planted by the waters, who spreads out its roots by the river, and will not fear when heat…

translations.web: They are bowed down and fallen, but we rise up, and stand upright.
translations.bsb: They collapse and fall, but we rise up and stand firm.
translations.kjv: They are brought down and fallen: but we are risen, and stand upright.
translations.asv: They are bowed down and fallen; But we are risen, and stand upright.
